"""Regression tests for clamp_limit(value, minimum, maximum).

Bug: clamp_limit only enforced the lower bound (`max(minimum, value)`),
so values above maximum escaped the documented inclusive upper interval.
"""
import pytest

from minicode.limits import clamp_limit


def test_within_interval_returns_value():
    assert clamp_limit(4, 2, 8) == 4
    assert clamp_limit(-1, -10, 10) == -1
    assert clamp_limit(0, -5, 5) == 0


def test_above_maximum_clamped_to_maximum():
    # Values above maximum must not escape the upper bound.
    assert clamp_limit(9, 2, 8) == 8
    assert clamp_limit(100, 2, 8) == 8
    assert clamp_limit(-3, -10, -5) == -5


def test_below_minimum_clamped_to_minimum():
    assert clamp_limit(0, 2, 8) == 2
    assert clamp_limit(-100, 2, 8) == 2


def test_boundaries_return_the_bound_itself():
    assert clamp_limit(2, 2, 8) == 2
    assert clamp_limit(8, 2, 8) == 8


def test_equal_bounds_are_valid():
    assert clamp_limit(7, 5, 5) == 5
    assert clamp_limit(5, 5, 5) == 5
    assert clamp_limit(3, 5, 5) == 5


def test_minimum_exceeds_maximum_raises_value_error():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        clamp_limit(4, 8, 2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        clamp_limit(0, 1, 0)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value,minimum,maximum,expected", [
    (4, 2, 8, 4),
    (0, 2, 8, 2),
    (9, 2, 8, 8),
    (2, 2, 8, 2),
    (8, 2, 8, 8),
    (-7, -5, -1, -5),
    (0, 5, 5, 5),
])
def test_clamp_limit_table(value, minimum, maximum, expected):
    assert clamp_limit(value, minimum, maximum) == expected


def test_inputs_are_not_modified():
    value, minimum, maximum = 4, 2, 8
    clamp_limit(value, minimum, maximum)
    assert (value, minimum, maximum) == (4, 2, 8)

"""Regression tests for case-insensitive extension matching in minicode.formats."""

from minicode.formats import accepts_extension


def test_case_insensitive_match_on_both_sides():
    assert accepts_extension("report.TXT", ["txt"]) is True
    assert accepts_extension("REPORT.txt", ["TXT"]) is True
    assert accepts_extension("Photo.JpG", ["jpg", "jpeg"]) is True
    assert accepts_extension("notes.md", ["MD"]) is True


def test_case_insensitive_negative_match():
    assert accepts_extension("report.TXT", ["pdf"]) is False
    assert accepts_extension("report.txt", ["TXTX"]) is False


def test_only_final_extension_counts():
    assert accepts_extension("archive.TAR.GZ", ["gz"]) is True
    assert accepts_extension("archive.tar.gz", ["tar"]) is False
    assert accepts_extension("site.backup.HTML", ["html"]) is True
    assert accepts_extension("a.b.c", ["b.c"]) is False


def test_dotfiles_and_missing_extensions_return_false():
    assert accepts_extension(".env", ["env"]) is False
    assert accepts_extension("dir/.ENV", ["env"]) is False
    assert accepts_extension("README", ["txt"]) is False
    assert accepts_extension("", ["txt"]) is False
    assert accepts_extension("file.", ["file"]) is False


def test_empty_allowed_returns_false():
    assert accepts_extension("report.txt", []) is False
    assert accepts_extension("report.TXT", ()) is False


def test_posix_path_separators():
    assert accepts_extension("dir/sub/REPORT.PDF", ["pdf"]) is True
    assert accepts_extension("dir/sub/report.pdf", ["PDF"]) is True


def test_bool_api_and_allowed_not_modified():
    assert type(accepts_extension("report.txt", ["txt"])) is bool
    assert type(accepts_extension("README", ["txt"])) is bool
    allowed_list = ["TXT", "Pdf"]
    accepts_extension("report.txt", allowed_list)
    assert allowed_list == ["TXT", "Pdf"]
    allowed_tuple = ("TXT", "Pdf")
    accepts_extension("report.TXT", allowed_tuple)
    assert allowed_tuple == ("TXT", "Pdf")

def accepts_extension(filename, allowed):
    """Match a nonempty final filename extension against allowed names."""
    suffix = PurePosixPath(filename).suffix.lstrip(".")
    return bool(suffix) and suffix in allowed
